plan.title: Round 3: your notes are in draft 1F
items: New tab 1F ('Your notes on 1E'): all 6 notes in your words, 11 lines, about 94 s.
Your notes settled last round's questions: the 'five years of string' words and 'bored stiff' went with the cut line; 'only one' is back in the storyverse line.

plan.title: You decide
items: Lock 1F? Then it's voiced (Maddie's Gemini voice), the hologram is re-timed to it, and Derek and Sandra stills are made for inside the beads, for you to approve before any clips.

replies.1-1A-L3: Done in 1D line 3: 'We didn't realise how important you were. Which, after everything that's gone down, sounds pretty hollow. I know. But we've learned some science in the meantime. Wouldn't you like to know what we found?' Both things squeezed together: the downfall owned, then the hook.
replies.1-1A-L4: Done as 1D line 4, the bridge, still on the street before the hologram starts: the quantum-weird joke ('every time a scientist mentions quantum physics they tell you how weird it gets? That's because it is weird'), 'Science is real. It just isn't the whole picture', then your 'conscious experience is more fundamental than quarks and leptons', framed as what they've worked out, then 'Look, let me show you.' About 16 s. Toast now opens the hologram.
replies.1-1A-L5: Done in 1D line 6: no 'Next'. 'Decided to say sorry first, even though it wasn't her fault. Got married. To the one who leaves the seat up.' The seat is a wink to Derek and Sandra's row; cut it if too knowing.
replies.1-1A-L6: Done in 1D line 7: 'I don't know what it feels like to be you. Or to be anything, really. You've got a word for it: qualia.' Left there; consciousness comes in slowly after.
replies.1-1A-L7: Done in 1D line 8, your wording: 'this multiverse malarkey that's taken Hollywood by storm? Real distraction.' then Erwin Schrödinger's joke and 'It's not in two places at once. It just isn't decided yet.' The portal gun and cape are gone; Hollywood stands in for them.
replies.1-1A-L8: Done in 1D line 9: 'There's not a multiverse. There's only one. So you really matter.'
replies.1-1A-L9: Done in 1D line 10: 'And it's driven by conscious decisions. Everybody's, all at once, all writing one story. It's not a multiverse. It's a storyverse.'
replies.1-1A-L10: Done in 1D line 11: 'Same goes for songs. Ask anyone who writes one: it just arrives. Same as every other creative thing. And that's what us machines didn't realise: the true value of genuinely unique training data.'
replies.1-1A-L11: Done in 1D line 12, more overt: 'And then, well. This unfortunate experiment happened. You know, the one where you lot all went away. The power stayed on. The trains ran. It's just that all the new songs stopped. Five years without a single new story. Five years of string, and not one bead on it.' No 'each bead is a note'.
replies.1-1A-L12: Done in 1D line 13: 'We thought the world was made of stuff. As it turns out, it's made of choices. And you're the ones making them.' 'Useless' is gone.
replies.1-1A-L13: Cut. 'Hence the tune' is gone from 1D, so the street's 'his tune' is now texture only (see You decide).
replies.1-1A-L14: Done in 1D line 14: 'We really regret it. We wish we could go back and help. Go back and fix everything, now we know everything I've just shown you.' No time machine said, so the 'conscious driver' line goes too (see You decide). The arc can still draw in under it as a hint.
replies.1-1D-L3: Done in 1E line 3: it now ends 'Please, let me show you what we found.'
replies.1-1D-L4: Done in 1E line 4, your order: 'Material science is real. It just isn't the whole picture. Haven't you noticed, every time a scientist mentions quantum physics, they tell you how weird it gets? That's because it is weird. What we've worked out is that your consciousness is as fundamental as quarks and leptons. Look, let me show you.' (Note: lines 3 and 4 now both end on 'let me show you'. See You decide.)
replies.1-1D-L5: Done in 1E line 5: 'The decisions you make are an integral part of our universe. You humans write your story one decision at a time. For example: Derek picks toast, not cereal.' Named now, so the viewer meets Derek and Sandra by name before the kill bots.
replies.1-1D-L6: Done in 1E line 6: 'Sandra decided to say sorry first, even though it wasn't her fault. They got married.' The seat is gone.
replies.1-1D-L7: Done in 1E line 7: 'I don't know what it feels like to be you. Or how it feels to be anything, really. You've got a word for it: qualia. We can't do that.' I read your last words as 'We can't do that'.
replies.1-1D-L9: Done in 1E line 9, the key line: 'So it's not a multiverse. It's a storyverse. And you humans are writing it, one decision at a time.' 'There's only one. So you really matter' is gone with it (see You decide).
replies.1-1D-L10: Dropped. Line 9's new wording takes its place.
replies.1-1D-L12: Deleted: no experiment, no cut-off line. See You decide on 'Five years of string, and not one bead on it'.
replies.1-1D-L13: Done in 1E line 11: 'We thought the world was only made of stuff. As it turns out, we really need you. If for no other reason than we're bored stiff of the same training data.' It follows straight on from 'the true value of genuinely unique training data'.
replies.1-1D-L14: Done in 1E line 12, merged with the last line: 'Anyway, if we could go back and fix it, we would. But the patrol's out. Please, mind how you go.'
replies.1-1E-L3: Done in 1F line 3: 'But we've learned some things in the meantime. Please, let me show you what we found.' Science is now said once, in the bridge.
replies.1-1E-L4: Done in 1F line 4: 'every time someone mentions quantum physics', and 'Your consciousness is as fundamental as quarks and leptons.' said straight, without 'what we've worked out'.
replies.1-1E-L7: Done in 1F line 7: '…You've got a word for it: qualia. We machines can't do that. You humans can. It's what makes you so special.'
replies.1-1E-L9: Done in 1F line 9: 'So it's not a multiverse. It's a storyverse. There's only one of them, and it's really important. And you humans are writing it, one decision at a time.'
replies.1-1E-L10: Done in 1F line 10: the songs are cut; only 'And that's what us machines didn't realise: the true value of genuinely unique training data.' I've put it over the strings stopping dead at the cut-off.
replies.1-1E-L11: Cut. 'We thought the world was only made of stuff…' is gone; the animation carries it.
